enrichment.headline: Hires Elite Security Services for up to $54,572 of patrol at The Center, with no competitive bid

money.evidence: for a total not to exceed $54,572.00

enrichment.summary: The district is hiring Elite Security Services, without competitive bidding, to keep providing private patrol security at The Center to prevent vandalism and for safety. The price is a fixed fee of $49,572 plus a $5,000 contingency, for a total of up to $54,572. Work was scheduled to start August 1, 2020, before this vote, and to last until December 31, 2020.

attachments.name: 20-1856 Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid – Innovative Construction Company – Madison Park Academy Project – Division of Facilities Planning & Management

enrichment.headline: Awards Innovative Construction $70,000 for ceiling work on the Madison Park Academy project
enrichment.sourceIssueCandidate: The title calls the site the Madison Park Academy Project, while the action text calls it the Madison Academy Expansion Project.
enrichment.summary: The district is awarding a contract to Innovative Construction Company, the lowest responsive and responsible bidder, for mechanical, electrical, plumbing, framing and drywall work on newly installed ceilings at Madison Park Academy. The $70,000 includes a $2,000 contingency. Work is scheduled to start October 15, 2020 and last 77 calendar days, ending December 31, 2020.
